rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when something physically becomes smaller or is made smaller.

example.english: The shirt did diminish in size after washing.
example.jyutping: gin6 saam1 sai2 jyun4 zi1 hau6 suk1 sai3 zo2

rows.note: Use this especially for amounts, numbers, frequency, or intensity becoming or being made less.

example.english: With less rain lately, the amount of water in the reservoirs has begun to diminish.
example.traditional: 近排落雨少咗，水塘嘅水量開始減少。
example.jyutping: gan6 paai2 lok6 jyu5 siu2 zo2 seoi2 tong4 ge3 seoi2 loeng6 hoi1 ci2 gaam2 siu2

rows.traditional: 將 A 講到冇咁重要
rows.jyutping: zoeng1 A gong2 dou3 mou5 gam3 zung6 jiu3
rows.note: Use this spoken pattern when deliberately downplaying A or making it sound less important than it is.

example.english: They always diminish the importance of their own achievements.
example.traditional: 佢成日將自己嘅功勞講到冇咁重要。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 zoeng1 zi6 gei2 ge3 gung1 lou4 gong2 dou3 mou5 gam3 zung6 jiu3
